description: Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon on static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js. GTM and query installs put the site token on the URL. Automatic injection puts it in data-cf-beacon instead. POST /cdn-cgi/rum is not contracted.

params.name: token
params.description: It is the Web Analytics site token. Cloudflare documents the GTM install as `beacon.min.js?token=`. Automatic injection sends the same token in `data-cf-beacon`, not the query.
params.fix_hint: For a tag-manager install, put the site token on the query as `token=`.

params.name: spa
params.description: Cloudflare documents `spa` on the beacon query for single-page apps.
params.fix_hint: Send `spa=false` or `spa=true` when you set it.
